Applying, being seen, messaging, verification and every safety feature stay free. We will never charge you to apply or to be visible. If anyone asks you for a fee on Calltime, it\'s a scam: report it.
What we might charge for later

string-array.name: ws7_tp_money_later
string-array.item: Pro tools for project owners: more active projects, PDF call sheets, release forms. A generous free tier for student and zero-budget films, with India-specific pricing.
Payment protection on paid gigs: a small fee paid by the production, never taken out of your rate.
Plans for film schools, festivals and challenge organisers. Their members still use the app free.
Clearly labelled boosts for paid projects only. Never on unpaid listings, never for applicants.

string-array.name: ws7_tp_money_never
string-array.item: Sell your data or your contact details.
Charge for verification or safety.
Let anyone pay to rank above you in a deck or a shortlist.
Put ads between you and a booking.

resources.string: Your reels, scripts, footage and messages are yours. We don\'t train AI on them, and we don\'t sell them to anyone who does.

string-array.name: ws7_tp_ai_pledge
string-array.item: We never use your work links, footage, scripts or messages to train generative AI.
We never generate reels, faces, voices or profiles. There are no AI headshots and no AI \"talent\" on Calltime.
Demo mode uses made-up people and projects, clearly marked DEMO. Live mode never shows fake activity.
Matching uses plain rules you can read: your roles, dates, distance, pay and track record.

resources.string: Simple pattern checks flag fee requests, contact details and unsafe meeting asks in chat, to protect you. They\'re word lists and rules, not a model trained on your messages.
We\'ll tell you in the app at least 30 days before, and you can export or delete everything first.
Six rules. They keep sets safe, keep people paid, and make every yes mean something.

string-array.name: ws7_rules_short
string-array.item: Say the pay up front: paid, stipend, or unpaid with what people get. No \"collab\", no \"exposure\".
Never charge cast or crew. No registration, audition or portfolio fees. Ever.
Keep talks on Calltime until you\'re booked. Contact details stay hidden until then.
Auditions happen in safe places: self-tape, video call, or a studio or public space with others present, 08:00–21:00. No nudity at auditions.
Keep your word, or give notice. Can\'t make it? Tell people at least 72 hours before. Productions that cut or cancel late show it on their record too.
Deliver what you promised: footage, final film, credit and pay, by the dates on the booking card.

resources.string: Report it from the profile, project, booking card or message. We aim to review every report within 24 hours. Breaking these rules can get listings hidden or an account closed.
We collect what\'s needed to get you booked, and we show other people even less.

Your work: roles, level, area (never your address), reels and links, confirmed credits and a track record of facts. Only people with a real connection can open your profile: a production whose role you applied to or who asked you, or people on the same shoot. Profiles are not a public directory.

resources.string: Most people on Calltime are here to make good work. This is what a real production does, and what it never asks for.

Self-tape, video call, or a studio or public space with others present, during the day (08:00–21:00). Sides come with the audition request in the app, so you never need to move to WhatsApp or meet anyone to get them. No nudity at auditions. Bring a friend if you like; you never have to meet alone.
No fees, ever: not for registration, auditions, portfolios or \"confirming\" a role. Pay goes from the production to you, never the other way.
Talks stay in Calltime. Contact details are hidden until you\'re booked, so nobody needs your number to cast you. You never need to send body photos or measurements to apply.

You get a day sheet with the full address, your call time, the nearest hospital and the wrap-by time. Share it with someone you trust. If the shoot is at a private home, the listing says so and a friend is welcome.

string-array.name: ws7_tp_normal_flags
string-array.item: A fee or deposit, for anything.
Moving to WhatsApp or a call before you\'re booked.
Asking for \"bold\" photos, measurements or body pictures.
Late-night auditions, or \"come alone\".
Plans changing to one-to-one at a private place.

resources.string: If you see one: leave, then report. We aim to review every report within 24 hours. In danger, call the emergency number first.
